In the 1998 season, Mark McGwire hit 70 home runs. The question asks whose record he broke that season.

Before 1998, the single-season home run record was 61, set by Roger Maris in 1961. Maris had broken Babe Ruth's record of 60 home runs (set in 1927) when he achieved that mark.

So in 1998, when McGwire hit 70 home runs, he was breaking Roger Maris's record of 61 home runs, not Babe Ruth's record (which had already been broken decades earlier by Maris).
